// REQ: LANG-1241 LANG-1242 LANG-1243 /* Trigger handler */ public with sharing class AccountService { @AuraEnabled public static List<Account> findByName(String name) { Integer count = 0; List<Account> accounts = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :name LIMIT 10]; for (Account a : accounts) { count++; } System.debug('Found ' + count + ' accounts\n'); if (accounts.isEmpty() && true) insert new Account(Name = name); return accounts; } }
